svg.title: Selective prefetch from the record stream
svg.desc: An illustrative 16-record window identifies the first occurrence of a distinct property line between leads eight and fifteen. Eligible candidates are ranked by decoded future distance, with ties favoring lead ten. Resident, pending and admission filters precede an eight-entry LLC-only queue. The request-based model is not a claim of native cycle timing.
svg.text: Selective prefetch from the record stream
No action bits are added to the edge word. All extra fills count as off-chip traffic.
A BOUNDED WINDOW, NOT A FUTURE TABLE
illustrative line IDs; separate from the checked fixture
Reject the current line and any line already seen earlier in the lookahead.
Rank eligible lines by the smallest decoded future bound; break ties toward lead 10.
the example chooses E at lead +10
At most 1 issue per 8 governed requests; configured latency is 8 governed requests.
FILL THE LLC, NOT THE PRIVATE CACHES
measure usefulness and total traffic separately
Fewer demand misses can include prefetched traffic. Count reads + writebacks, not demand misses alone.
FlowThrough is OFF in the primary Scale6 comparisons; this prefetch path is a separate mechanism.
